newsitem.title: USA: Varco preliminary Q4 orders $163.2 mln. [CORRECTED 23:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Varco preliminary Q4 orders $163.2 mln. [CORRECTED 23:16 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear company is referring to orders and not revenues.)
Varco International Inc said on Tuesday that preliminary orders for the fourth quarter, ended December 31, 1996, were about $163.2 million, the highest quarterly total in the company's history.
In the fourth quarter of 1995 the company had orders of $85.6 million. The previous record for orders was in the third quarter of 1996 when the company had orders of $128.0 million.

The company said in a statement the high level of order bookings is due to the strength of the offshore rig market, and the resulting demand for equipment to upgrade existing rigs, as well as to equip certain new rigs scheduled to commence construction during the next few months.
The majority of the fourth quarter orders will be delivered during 1997, it said.
